model: onnx-community/embeddinggemma-2-ONNX q4 (model_q4.onnx), mean pool, prefixes 'task: search result | query: ' / 'title: none | text: '
query: prompt + 1 prior exchange (H1 text format of data/texts-v2-depth.json)
note: p = sigmoid(bias + Σ w_j (x_j − mean_j)/sd_j); inject top 3 (active, existing notes, ranked by score CENTERED on the mean of the active note vectors) when p ≥ cutoffP. top = RAW cosine of the top-1 note. Fitted on v2 300; v1 43/80, v3 145/200 (q4, centering = mean of notes).
